text:
as with most things, think Seneca nailed this one

if I had to make a list of the top 10 ppl I know who are really “walking the walk,” they were wrong before they were right.

quotedTweet.text: “There is no man to whom a good mind comes before an evil one. It is the evil mind that gets first hold on all of us. Learning virtue means unlearning vice.” Seneca
